template.name: Obstacle Corridor Detour Survey
template.description: One drone crosses a corridor containing a no-entry block and photographs both ends. The avoided obstacle must be present in the scenario.
template.content: Cover the corridor from ({randx_wp1:120:240:1}, {randy_wp1:120:240:1}) to ({randx_wp2:760:900:1}, {randy_wp2:520:660:1}) with {drone_name} flying at {random_alt:22:30:1} meters. A blocked structure ({obstacle_name}) sits between the two ends: stay at least {random_clear:40:60:0} meters away from it and take two photographs, one at each end, then hover at the far end when finished.
content_aliases: {drone_name} flies the corridor from ({randx_wp1:120:240:1}, {randy_wp1:120:240:1}) to ({randx_wp2:760:900:1}, {randy_wp2:520:660:1}) at {random_alt:22:30:1} m, avoiding {obstacle_name} with a {random_clear:40:60:0} m margin, photo at both ends.
Detour survey: {drone_name} at {random_alt:22:30:1} m, does not enter the {obstacle_name} footprint, takes two photos and hovers at the far end.
Fly {drone_name} through the corridor while keeping clear of {obstacle_name}, altitude {random_alt:22:30:1} m.
